name: Ace of Cups
title: Ace of Cups
imagery: A single great cup fills the card, built like a small cathedral with towers and arches. It is ornate, generous and open at the top, a vessel ready to receive and to give.
meaning: The Ace of Cups is the source of love and feeling. A new emotional beginning, a deep connection or a wave of grace is offered to you. Open your heart and let it fill.
numerology: The Ace is the seed of the suit, all the power of Water in one vessel.
affirmation: My heart is open and full.

ctx.past: An opening of the heart in your past still nourishes you.
ctx.present: Love, compassion or intuition is flowing in now. Receive it.
ctx.future: A new love, friendship or emotional renewal is coming.
ctx.challenge: A closed heart or emotional overflow without boundaries.
ctx.advice: Open your heart. Let yourself feel and receive.
ctx.self: You feel tender, loving and open.
ctx.hopes: You hope for love and fear being hurt.
ctx.love: A new romance or deepened love.
ctx.work: Work that touches the heart or a creative gift.
ctx.spirit: Your guides pour grace into your cup.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be longing you have not expressed.
ctx.gift: Your gift is an open, loving heart.

name: Two of Cups
title: Two of Cups
imagery: Two cups stand side by side beneath a decorative motif of flowers, often with two creatures or a banner rising between them. The cups mirror each other.
meaning: The Two of Cups is a meeting of hearts. Mutual attraction, friendship or partnership flowers. Feelings are shared and returned.
numerology: Two is union and encounter, here between hearts.
affirmation: I give and receive love equally.

ctx.past: A meaningful bond shaped your heart.
ctx.present: A connection is forming or deepening now.
ctx.future: A partnership or new love is coming.
ctx.challenge: Imbalance or codependence in a bond.
ctx.advice: Meet others heart to heart. Share honestly.
ctx.others: A partner or close friend is central.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear of intimacy.
ctx.gift: Your gift is the ability to bond deeply.

name: Three of Cups
title: Three of Cups
imagery: Three cups are arranged in a triangle with flowers and leaves weaving around them. The pattern is lively and full.
meaning: The Three of Cups brings joy shared with others. Celebrations, friendship and emotional abundance are favored. Gather with those you love.
numerology: Three is growth and the fruit of union.
affirmation: I celebrate with the people I love.

ctx.present: It is a time to celebrate with friends.
ctx.future: A celebration or reunion is coming.
ctx.love: Joyful romance or a celebration of love.

name: Four of Cups
title: Four of Cups
imagery: Four cups stand in a square, two above and two below, with a flower motif at the center. The arrangement is calm and orderly.
meaning: The Four of Cups is emotional stability. Feelings are settled and secure. Enjoy this calm, but watch that comfort does not become apathy.
numerology: Four is stability and structure in the realm of feeling.
affirmation: I appreciate the emotional security I have.

ctx.past: A calm, secure period shaped you.
ctx.present: Emotions are stable. Rest in that.
ctx.future: A peaceful, settled time is coming.
ctx.advice: Appreciate what you have, but stay open.
ctx.self: You feel content, perhaps a little withdrawn.
ctx.love: Stable love that may need fresh energy.

name: Five of Cups
title: Five of Cups
imagery: Five cups are arranged around a central cup, with leaves and flowers weaving between them. The order of four is broken by a fifth.
meaning: The Five of Cups disturbs emotional stability. Disappointment or loss shakes things up, but it also opens the door to new feelings and growth.
numerology: Five breaks the stability of four and brings change.
affirmation: I honor my feelings and open to what comes next.

ctx.past: A past disappointment still affects you.
ctx.present: Something has upset the emotional balance.
ctx.challenge: Dwelling on loss is the obstacle.
ctx.advice: Grieve, then look to what remains.
ctx.others: Others may disappoint or surprise you.
ctx.love: A disappointment or change in love.
ctx.work: A setback that leads to new direction.
ctx.spirit: Your guides support you through loss.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be unprocessed grief.

name: Six of Cups
title: Six of Cups
imagery: Six cups stand in two columns of three, with a flowering stem between them. The pattern is balanced and gentle.
meaning: The Six of Cups brings emotional harmony and simple pleasures. Kindness, sweet memories and innocence return. Enjoy the gentle joy of the heart.

ctx.future: A pleasant reunion or kindness is coming.
ctx.advice: Enjoy simple pleasures and be kind.
ctx.others: An old friend or loved one returns.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be longing for the past.

name: Seven of Cups
title: Seven of Cups
imagery: Seven cups stand in rows, with one placed apart in the center. Leaves twine around them, creating a rich, almost overwhelming display.
meaning: The Seven of Cups opens the realm of imagination and options. Many choices or dreams appear. Choose wisely and stay grounded.

ctx.past: Dreams and wishes guided past choices.
ctx.advice: Choose one dream and act on it.
ctx.others: Others may tempt you with options.
ctx.hopes: You hope for your wishes to come true.

name: Eight of Cups
title: Eight of Cups
imagery: Eight cups fill the card in rows, with flowers weaving through. The arrangement is full and balanced.
meaning: The Eight of Cups is emotional maturity. You may be ready to move beyond what once satisfied you, searching for deeper meaning.
numerology: Eight is movement and power in balance.

ctx.present: You may be ready to move on.
ctx.future: A search for deeper meaning is coming.
ctx.work: Leaving a job for a deeper calling.
ctx.spirit: Your guides invite a spiritual quest.

name: Nine of Cups
title: Nine of Cups
imagery: Nine cups are arranged in rows, with one in the center. The card is full and overflowing.
meaning: The Nine of Cups is the wish card. Emotional satisfaction and abundance are yours. Enjoy and be grateful.
numerology: Nine is near completion and fulfillment.

ctx.past: A wish fulfilled in the past.
ctx.advice: Enjoy and share your good fortune.
ctx.hopes: Your hope is close to fulfillment.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be fear it will not last.

name: Ten of Cups
title: Ten of Cups
imagery: Ten cups fill the card, with a large cup lying across the top above nine standing below. The design feels complete.
meaning: The Ten of Cups is emotional completion. Family, home and lasting happiness are highlighted. A cycle of feeling is fulfilled.
numerology: Ten is completion and a new cycle.
affirmation: I share lasting joy with those I love.

ctx.past: A happy home or family shaped you.
ctx.present: Harmony and family joy are here.
ctx.hopes: You hope for a happy home.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be family tension.

name: Page of Cups
title: Valet of Cups
imagery: A young valet stands holding a cup, sometimes with its lid lifted, gazing at it with curiosity. He is tender and open.
meaning: The Valet of Cups brings emotional messages and creative beginnings. Be open to new feelings and imaginative ideas.
numerology: The Valet is the student of the suit.
affirmation: I welcome new feelings with curiosity.

ctx.present: A new feeling or idea is emerging.
ctx.others: A gentle young person is involved.

name: Knight of Cups
title: Knight of Cups
imagery: A knight rides calmly, holding a cup outstretched before him as if offering it. His movement is graceful rather than urgent.
meaning: The Knight of Cups brings romance and invitations. He follows his heart and offers love or creative proposals.
numerology: The Knight carries the suit into the world.

ctx.future: Romance or a heartfelt proposal is coming.
ctx.advice: Follow your heart with eyes open.
ctx.spirit: Your guides call you to follow your heart.

name: Queen of Cups
title: Queen of Cups
imagery: A queen sits holding a large covered cup with care, her expression calm and inward. She guards her feelings and her wisdom.
meaning: The Queen of Cups is compassionate and intuitive. She understands feelings deeply and offers loving care.
numerology: The Queen holds the suit inwardly.
affirmation: I trust my intuition and care deeply.

ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be absorbed feelings.

name: King of Cups
title: King of Cups
imagery: A king sits holding a cup steadily, his posture relaxed and dignified. He is master of his feelings.
meaning: The King of Cups is calm, wise and generous. He balances heart and mind and leads with compassion.
numerology: The King holds the suit outwardly with mastery.
affirmation: I lead with a calm, wise heart.

ctx.past: A wise, kind man influenced you.
ctx.shadow: Hidden here may be hidden feelings.
